info.title: IntentDataPlaneService
info.description: Intent authoring and matching API for one Router. An intent is a named classification with example phrasings and an optional dispatch target; matching returns the intents closest to a query. Intents and examples are ordered lists: they are returned in the order they were created.

post.description: Removes everything the scope names. With INTENTS every intent and example of the Router is deleted and the Router itself stays. The scope is required: there is no default.

parameters.description: Opaque Router identifier.

put.description: Creates or replaces one intent. Idempotent: the same request twice yields the same state. 201 when the intent is new, 200 when it replaced one, which keeps its place in the list. Existing phrasings absent from the request are removed after the new ones are written, so a concurrent match never sees an empty intent. Send `If-None-Match: *` to create only: if the intent already exists the request is refused with 412 and nothing is written, and the check is atomic with the write, so of several concurrent creates exactly one succeeds.
